name: Granular Multi-Dimensional Open Weights Correlation Model
description: Deterministic, 4-dimensional confidence scoring weights for cybersecurity incident verification, evidence quality, source corroboration, and temporal decay.

CONFIRMED BY REGULATOR.description: Official government regulatory filings (e.g. SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05, State AG breach notifications, HHS OCR).

GOVERNMENT ADVISORY.description: Statutory government & national cybersecurity agency directives and alerts (e.g. CISA BOD directives & KEV catalog, UK NCSC emergency alerts, FBI cyber advisories).

CONFIRMED BY TARGET.description: Direct public confirmation from the target organization or software vendor (official security bulletin, press release, status bulletin).

INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION.description: Technical telemetry, investigative reporting, or sample data validation by reputable cybersecurity researchers.

ACKNOWLEDGED.description: Target public acknowledgment of IT disruption or active investigation without breach admission.

UNVERIFIED CLAIM.description: Unilateral threat actor claim, leak site listing, dark web forum dump, or community chatter.

REFUTED.description: Proven false alarm, recycled historical leak, or public web scrape mislabeled as an intrusion.
